purpose: Teach: フェニックス/ユビキタス/フェデラー/バレンシア/ルックス/ゴッホ/スタンフォード大/寝たきり

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、不死鳥のフェニックスの絵を描かれてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer who came in — the one painting the phoenix? Aoi was talking about them.
lines.style: Soft, almost thinking aloud. Gentle observation shared like a small confidence. Warm rhythm, no hurry. Slight lift at the end, inviting Aoi into the thought.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ユビキタス社会の研究をされてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: The one doing research on ubiquitous society? Yeah, they mentioned that to me too.
lines.style: Quiet agreement, mirroring Mei's tone. Thoughtful pause before speaking. Tender recognition that they're both noticing the same person. Steady, almost intimate delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、フェデラー選手のテニスファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They're a huge Federer fan, apparently. That's what they told me.
lines.style: Small smile in the voice. Conversational, light touch. Sharing a detail like it's a small secret between them. Natural, unforced rhythm.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、バレンシアに留学経験がおありだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They studied abroad in Valencia, actually. Spent time there.
lines.style: Gentle affirmation. Speaking as if remembering along with Mei. Steady tone, no performance. The warmth of two people piecing something together.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ルックスより中身が大事って仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They said appearance doesn't matter — what's inside is what counts.
lines.style: Tender, almost reverent at this observation. Slower pace. A quiet moment recognizing something true being spoken. Slight breath before the phrase, as if it landed.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ゴッホの個展に行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They went to see a Van Gogh exhibition. They mentioned that.
lines.style: Soft, remembering. Thoughtful pacing. The tone of someone noticing how much this person contains. No rush, just sharing what sticks.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、スタンフォード大に留学された方だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They studied at Stanford, didn't they? That's what I understood.
lines.style: Quiet confirmation. Gentle certainty in the voice. A small nod underneath the words. Warm but measured, respecting the weight of knowing things about someone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご家族が寝たきりで介護されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Their family member — they're bedridden. They're the one providing the care.
lines.style: Softer still, almost a whisper. The careful gentleness of speaking about something tender and real. Steady breath, no rush. Like a small prayer of understanding. Close, intimate, held.
